name: search-results
title: Search results
description: Best match in its card with the written answer or the passage, the pages around it and its source; then the other matches as quiet lines, each opening in place to its passage. The query's words are in medium weight, and each opened result can download its document.
use_for: A person checking what Conare finds, from Home, the sidebar or a namespace.
never: A results page that leaves for another page to read a passage: lines open in place
Colour alone for the query's words: they are medium weight in ink
source: conare-web app/components/console/search/BestMatch.vue, Answer.vue, PagePreview.vue, app/components/console/Marked.vue, app/utils/marks.ts, app/assets/css/console2.css (.v2-rise, .v2-others, .v2-match, .v2-expand, .v2-pg, .v2-cite, [data-flash])
body:
The query's words are marked with `marked-text`. Pass `download` (a function taking the result) and the best match and
each opened match end on the dark Download button from `document-download`, which says Downloaded once it has; hand it
`useDocumentDownload()` with your API's bytes. The `actions` slot adds other buttons beside it.

examples.name: Product
examples.label: In the product
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import SearchResults from '@/components/product/SearchResults.vue'
import { resultKey, type SearchResult } from '@/composables/useSearchResults'
import { useDocumentDownload } from '@/composables/useDocumentDownload'
// The results alone, as Home shows them under the box: the best match in its card with the written answer, the pages
// around its passage and its source, then the other matches, each opening in place. Press a citation to show its
// result; Download saves the document (sample text stands in for your API's bytes).
const query = 'Acme renewal EU data'
const results: SearchResult[] = [
  { namespace: 'contracts', id: 'acme-msa-2026', score: 0.94, page: { number: 9, count: 24, top: 0.3, file: 'acme-msa-2026.pdf' }, text: 'Acme may renew for twelve months with 60 days written notice. On renewal, all customer data stays in the EU region named in Schedule C.' },
  { namespace: 'slack', id: 'legal-thread-1182', score: 0.81, text: 'Legal confirmed that Acme needs EU data residency in the renewal, and that Schedule C covers it.' },
  { namespace: 'sales-calls', id: 'acme-oct-review', score: 0.76, text: 'Acme asked what happens to their data at renewal. We walked through the EU region and the 60 day notice.' },
  { namespace: 'crm', id: 'acme-renewal-2026', score: 0.71, text: 'Renewal open. Blocker: data processing addendum for the EU region.' },
]
const answer = 'Acme can renew for twelve months with 60 days written notice [1], and its data stays in the EU region named in Schedule C [1][2]. The open blocker is the data processing addendum [4].'
const save = useDocumentDownload()
const download = (r: SearchResult) => save(resultKey(r), () => new Promise<string>(done => setTimeout(() => done(r.text), 400)), `${r.id}.txt`)
</script>

<template>
  <SearchResults :results="results" :query="query" :answer="answer" :download="download" />
</template>

examples.content:
<!-- The results alone, as Home shows them under the box: the best match in its card with the written answer, the
     pages around its passage and its source, then the other matches, each opening in place. Press a citation to show
     its result; Download saves the document (sample text stands in for your API's bytes). -->
<conare-search-results query="Acme renewal EU data"></conare-search-results>
<script type="module">
  const list = document.querySelector('conare-search-results')
  list.results = [
    { namespace: 'contracts', id: 'acme-msa-2026', score: 0.94, page: { number: 9, count: 24, top: 0.3, file: 'acme-msa-2026.pdf' }, text: 'Acme may renew for twelve months with 60 days written notice. On renewal, all customer data stays in the EU region named in Schedule C.' },
    { namespace: 'slack', id: 'legal-thread-1182', score: 0.81, text: 'Legal confirmed that Acme needs EU data residency in the renewal, and that Schedule C covers it.' },
    { namespace: 'sales-calls', id: 'acme-oct-review', score: 0.76, text: 'Acme asked what happens to their data at renewal. We walked through the EU region and the 60 day notice.' },
    { namespace: 'crm', id: 'acme-renewal-2026', score: 0.71, text: 'Renewal open. Blocker: data processing addendum for the EU region.' },
  ]
  list.answer = 'Acme can renew for twelve months with 60 days written notice [1], and its data stays in the EU region named in Schedule C [1][2]. The open blocker is the data processing addendum [4].'
  // Download: the button's own download, keyed by the result, with the passage as the document.
  list.download = (r) => {
    const key = `${r.namespace}/${r.id}`
    const button = [...list.shadowRoot.querySelectorAll('conare-download-button')].find((b) => b.doc === key)
    button?.download(() => new Promise((done) => setTimeout(() => done(r.text), 400)), `${r.id}.txt`)
  }
</script>
